card.name: Contacting a poison control center
card.fires_on: Words just before the poison control phone number in overdose advice, such as 'contact', 'a', 'at' or an opening parenthesis after 'Poison Control Center'.

modes.label: Opening parenthesis before number
modes.description: The '(' right after 'poison control center' that introduces the 1-800 phone number.

modes.label: Contact verb or article
modes.description: 'contact' or 'a' leading into 'a Poison Control Center' in accidental overdose warnings.
modes.example: In case of accidental overdose, seek professional assistance or<< contact>> a Poison Control Center immediately.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese and English words about meeting or neighbors.
card.plain: It lights up when a label tells the reader to call a poison control center after an overdose.
